UI Inventory

Every top-level navigation destination, its tabs, and what's actually on screen — pulled from the live sidebar (Layout.jsx), the route table (App.jsx), and a logged-in screenshot pass against the running SPA. Six groups plus Administration's own 8-tab sub-nav.

Platformno pillar — sits above the five groups
/DashboardAutomation Trust Index + Enforcement Activity hero cards, 4 stat tiles (Policies/Active/Incidents/Models), Open Incidents + Recent Policies lists
Governancepolicy definitions, violations, enforcement, MCP registry
/governancePoliciesPolicy table (Name/Status/Version/Violations/Created); detail modal holds Rules + Bindings editors and the Observe/Warn/Enforce mode toggle
/violationsViolationsStatus + Severity filters; table expands in-place to a waiver panel and status history timeline per row
/enforcementEnforcement4-card decision-outcome strip, By-Policy breakdown table, raw enforcement-events table with correlation IDs
/mcp-registryMCP RegistryRegistryDiscoveredRegistry tab: server table + detail modal (tools, credential exposure, assurance evidence, unified history)
/mcp-registryMCP RegistryRegistryDiscoveredDiscovered tab: scan queue from the discovery-agent CLI, Promote / Dismiss actions, diff-since-last-scan
Riskn8n workflow risk scoring
/workflowsWorkflowsSummaryWorkflowsNode TypesBy DomainSummary tab: stat cards, risk distribution bar, PII-exposure and hardcoded-secrets tables, top-risk-workflows list
Assurancerecoverability evidence, data lineage, anomaly detection
/assuranceAssuranceAuto-collected platform health tiles (API Gateway / DB / n8n / Containers) + per-workflow evidence table
/lineageData LineageSummary strip (chains/violations/external/cross-border), chain table expanding to an SVG data-flow DAG
/anomalyAnomaly DetectionAlertsBaselinesAttack PathsAlerts tab: 5-card severity strip, expandable alert rows with deviation score and correlation ID
Runtime Intelligencetelemetry, inference, audit, escalation
/telemetryTelemetrySummaryChartAI cost & tokensRawSummary tab: per-service/metric cards (avg/min/max, sample count)
/inferenceAI InferenceModelsRequestsDecisionsModels tab: registry table (Name/Version/Status/Endpoint/Sanctioned) — this is what EP-201-F5 now enforces against
/auditAudit Log4-column filter grid (Actor/Resource/Event/Outcome), append-only events table, raw event-detail modal
/escalationEscalationIncidentsRulesIncidents tab: table + detail modal with containment actions (Suspend/Quarantine/Restore/Rollback) and notification log
Business ValueROI modeling
/roiROI IntelligenceLive/Manual data toggle, 6 assumption sliders, value/ROI/payback stat cards, pillar-by-pillar before/after breakdown

/admin/tagsTagsTag registry table with inline add/edit rows
/admin/waiversWaiversWaiver table with expiry-urgency labels and Approve/Deny actions
/admin/approval-chainsApproval ChainsChain-template table + pending-approvals table with an inline decision panel

/admin/control-testsControl Tests3-card pass/fail/pending strip, test table expanding to per-run history
